'''Am Serro''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Along with [[Lens Reekeene]], [[Mikka Reekeene]] and [[Santhou Lazith'chika]], Serro debriefed Rebel operative [[Tay Vanis]] at the modified freighter ''[[Home]]'' after Vanis had completed his twentieth mission.
